faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about learning with us.

items.a: Classes are held live via video conferencing in our interactive virtual classroom. You can interact with your tutor and peers in real-time, just like an in-person class.

items.q: Do I need any prior knowledge of German?
items.a: Not at all! Our A1 Beginner course is designed for complete beginners. If you have some knowledge, you can take our free placement test.

items.q: Can I cancel or reschedule a class?
items.a: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel a class up to 24 hours in advance without any penalty through your student portal.
Our courses align with the CEFR standards. We provide a certificate of completion. For official recognition (like visas), our exam prep courses prepare you for the official Goethe/TELC exams.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers. We also offer flexible installment plans for longer courses.
